summary: Split god module nxdo_discovery by responsibility

delivery.outcome: Split src/koru/autonomy/nxdo_discovery.py (code2llm GOD: 550 lines, 4 classes) by responsibility into three modules behind a stable facade: nxdo_config.py (os.environ-then-.env knob lookup _dotenv_value/_config_value/_env_flag/_env_float/_env_int, nxdo_enabled, nxdo binary resolution _nxdo_executable, API-key detection _api_key_available, KORU_NXDO_REPOS glob expansion nxdo_target_repos, and the subprocess contract Runner/DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS/_default_runner), nxdo_cooldown.py (per-repo cost-control stamps DEFAULT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS/STAMP_RELPATH/_stamp_path/_load_stamps/_save_stamps/_CooldownSelection/_select_target_repo) and nxdo_tickets.py (TaskPlan parsing and planfile filing DEFAULT_SOURCE/DEFAULT_MAX_TICKETS/_PRIORITY_MAP/_plan_from_output/_slug/_dedupe_key/_existing_nxdo_dedupe_keys/_ticket_text/_ticket_scaffold/_PlanFiling/_apply_plan_tickets). nxdo_discovery.py keeps only the pipeline (NxdoDiscoveryOutcome, _Preflight, _preflight, _nxdo_command, _execute, _record_attempt, _failure_message, _interpret_plan, run_nxdo_discovery, format_nxdo_summary) and re-exports every moved name with redundant aliases so 'from koru.autonomy.nxdo_discovery import ...' stays byte-compatible, including the test-facing _nxdo_executable patch target and _dedupe_key. Behavior is preserved verbatim (functions move unmodified); tests/test_nxdo_discovery.py passes unchanged and tests/test_nxdo_modules.py pins the moved behavior at its new homes plus the facade re-export surface and the facade-level _nxdo_executable patch path.
nonGoals: Changing planning behavior, skip reasons, cooldown semantics, dedupe keys or ticket scaffolds
Renaming environment knobs, defaults or the os.environ-before-.env lookup order
Touching src/koru/autonomy/phases/scan_phase.py or any other consumer of run_nxdo_discovery
Splitting or refactoring any other module flagged by code2llm

architecture.decision: Move functions verbatim (same private names) into three responsibility modules and re-export them from the koru.autonomy.nxdo_discovery facade with redundant aliases (the koru.queue.context pattern from the earlier queue split). A patch audit found exactly one facade-level monkeypatch target (tests patch nd._nxdo_executable, consumed by _preflight, which stays in the facade and resolves the name through facade globals at call time) and one cross-module patch target (koru.tasks.create_nl_task, consumed by _apply_plan_tickets through a function-local import), so plain import-time re-exports suffice without call-time facade indirection; the facade __all__ is unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit to restore the single 550-line src/koru/autonomy/nxdo_discovery.py.

validation.evidence: nxdo_discovery.py drops from 550 lines to the pipeline facade; each responsibility module stays a focused non-god module (<500 lines, <4 classes).
Existing nxdo and scan-phase suites pass unchanged.

commands: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "from koru.autonomy.nxdo_discovery import (DEFAULT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS, DEFAULT_MAX_TICKETS, DEFAULT_SOURCE, DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, STAMP_RELPATH, NxdoDiscoveryOutcome, Runner, format_nxdo_summary, nxdo_enabled, nxdo_target_repos, run_nxdo_discovery, _dedupe_key, _nxdo_executable); print('facade stable')"
validation.evidence: Every pre-split import path (public and private) still resolves through the facade and src/koru/autonomy/phases/scan_phase.py is unmodified.
New focused suite passes at the new module homes and the governance gate passes with 0 errors from the ticket worktree.
